# Link checker (community, Node only)

Every Monday it checks each distinct outside link on public pages once (HEAD) and stores a report of the broken ones by page (`linkCheckerReport`, also offered through MCP).

It must reach hosts nobody can list in advance, so `egress` is `{ any: true, reason }`, which shows as the derived tag `reaches-any-host`. Core's SSRF guard still refuses private and link-local addresses: they are reported as `refused` and never requested.

<!-- implements:start (generated by scripts/plugin-docs.mjs from plugin.yaml and the docblocks in the code; do not edit by hand) -->
## What it implements

| Kind | Name | Runs when | What this plugin does |
|---|---|---|---|
| operation | `linkCheckerReport` | `GET /x/api/v1/plugins/<id>/report` (bearerAuth) | Returns the report from the last weekly check. |
| schedule | `check` | `17 3 * * 1` | Sends one HEAD request to each distinct outside link on listed pages, every Monday, and stores a report of those that answer 4xx/5xx, are unreachable or are refused as private addresses. |

Each code row matches a docblock (`Implements hook ...`, `Implements operation ...`) directly above the implementation in `src/nodejs`.
